CustomField.description: Contributor Order Form "Date" column (20 Sep 2026, Kam): point-in-time products print this one date. Sources in order - the line Product Date, the product's own Product Date (the copy to the line is missing on about a quarter of lines), the parent line's date for zero-fee add-ons such as Bespoke PDF, then the SUN Report start date. Time-Based products print it as the start of their period, with Order Form: end date alongside.
CustomField.label: Order Form: date
